scope: Contributor-only synthetic diagnostic; no primary trial, native checkpoint admission or deployment

method.base: existing dense_causal_reward, same frozen raw fitted scores and public rows
controls: NC1 rolling null mixture reproduced from the same raw predictions
method.candidate: Two-state fixed-share Bayesian filter over current dense forecast and fair null. Start w=0.5; prequential predict p=0.5+w*(q-0.5); posterior u=w*L/(w*L+(1-w)*0.5), L=q for consequence 1 else 1-q; next w=1/64+(1-2/64)*u. No phase reset or label. Freeze source weight at A96. All arms choose the identical uncalibrated dense argmax; no action gain asserted.
method.exposure: A96 B64 R64 identical forced public rows; 32 held queries per B/R phase not observed by learner. Same base fitted state may be shared in evaluator because calibration cannot change training or action choice; independently count standalone-equivalent serialized bytes and rule work. Three-way comparison includes NC1 exactly using its 32-entry rounded log likelihood formula.
method.retention: Checksum-protected candidate snapshot contains dense checkpoint, current and source weights; restore at A and B; check immutable source function on fixed public probe contexts; same-process snapshots only, not independent process-exit proof.
method.hypothesis: A bounded per-step transition permits recovery from temporary evidence shocks without a 32-sample hard cutoff.
method.stop: No tuning on scored seeds. On any threshold failure record NO-GO and stop this calibration line pending independent review, not another parameter sweep.

classification: All thresholds necessary for diagnostic target attainment only; no scientific pass, independently qualified strongest control, active learning or native gain. Full exact-head regression required; no new workflow or manual dispatch.
